notes: CNSA/CNGBdb access terms independently reviewed 2026-08-24 (the source_url previously recorded here, ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gsub/..., was itself a dead link/404 -- corrected to the real CNGBdb project page). Both CNP0002540 (scRNA-seq, 7 samples/93 runs) and CNP0003321 (spatial transcriptomics, 10 samples/10 runs) confirmed controlled-access, not public: the project page states "The data is not public because the submitter's settings." Access requires a Data Access Center (DAC) application -- download a request-form template and email it to datasubs@genomics.cn -- and approval is granted solely at the discretion of the original data submitter (Wang Fei / 王菲, Guangdong Academy of Medical Sciences), with no stated turnaround time ("processing time... mainly depends on the review time of the data submitter"). Applications additionally require the requesting PI, institution, and all collaborators to guarantee compliance with China's Human Genetic Resources (HGR) regulations, since this is human genetic data of Chinese origin -- a real regulatory step, not a formality, and outside what this repository or its operator can satisfy directly (no Chinese-institution affiliation on record here). This is a genuine, real access blocker, not a "hasn't been reviewed yet" placeholder -- no per-file inventory, no per-run checksum, no data downloaded, and none of that is expected to change without a real DAC application being filed and approved by an eligible institution.
